mostWorthwhile.text: Adding particles to the mucus-covered lining was most worthwhile: it showed how mucus catches them and the hairs move them toward the throat.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the mucus-covered lining was the least interesting part on its own; the result was predictable, and adding particles made its purpose clearer.

surprise.text: I wasn't sure exactly how the white blood cell would catch bacteria; the result showed it surrounding one, which then broke apart.

arbitrary.text: Neither pairing felt arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained what each defense was supposed to do. The compatible options also supplied the pairings, so I didn't discover them myself.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter if it showed another body defense as clearly, though these choices were fairly predictable.
